content.text:
I've added a gate in [i:/Scratch/_trimtest/T4-B-3/proxy.ts](proxy.ts) that protects `/partners` with the same password login as `/client`. It isn't committed. Type-checking `proxy.ts` gave no errors, but I haven't sent a real request through it, so a missing cookie redirecting to `/client/login` is untested.

- **How it works:** the gate checks for the same signed `sol_client` cookie as `/client` (Gate 2a, just after the `/client` gate). That cookie is only issued after a per-client password is checked. Without a valid one, the visitor is sent to `/client/login`. It also catches encoded and `../` versions of the path, like the other gates do.
- **No page yet:** the repo has no `app/partners` route, so a signed-in visitor will get a 404 until you build the page.
- **Risk to decide on:** any client who can sign in to `/client` can open `/partners`, including every client workspace. That is what "same password check" means. If partners should be a separate group, you'll need a list of allowed workspace slugs (checked with `sessionGrantsSlug`) or their own credentials instead.
